summary: Iteration 34 — verified Round Corners (Paper + Substrate) and Rush Pricing features. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_round_corners_and_rush.py (8/8 pass) covering (a) Settings model exposes rush_same_day_pct, rush_next_day_pct, rc_paper_*, rc_substrate_* fields; (b) PUT /api/settings persists both rush_next_day_pct and rc_paper_per_stack with reload verification (values restored after each test); (c) POST /api/calc/paper with round_corners=true returns per-row round_corner_cost = max(min, ceil(qty/pps)*per_stack), and round_corner_retail/wholesale = markup(cost, pct) reduced by any volume discount factor; (d) round_corners=false → rc fields = 0 on every row; (e) POST /api/calc/directprint with round_corners=true adds rc_cost via rc_substrate_* settings and adds delta to base_cost; (f) laminate + round_corners together return both non-zero on same row (regression). Frontend: playwright verified in browser — Paper Printing toggles roundcorners-switch → generate quote → PricingPanel shows '· Round Corners' line ($7.60 @ qty=100 with actual settings pps=25, per_stack=$2, min=$5, BC product markup=0%, volume-discount 5% = 4×$2×0.95=$7.60 ✓); rush-pricing table shows Standard $26.98 / $19.86, Next day +10% $29.68 / $21.84, Same day +15% $31.03 / $22.83 (formulas verified). Turning switch OFF and re-quote → price-roundcorner disappears (count=0). Direct Print /direct-print: dp-round-corners toggle ON → Compare Materials → '· Round Corners' line = $24.00 for 4 panels (4×$2 substrate cost × 200% markup = $24 exactly, then $790.59 retail includes it), rush-pricing table present. Stickers module rush-pricing table also present with std_retail=$31.85. Settings UI: setting-rush_next_day_pct field editable, changed 10→12, save-settings-button posts, reload shows 12, restored to 10 successfully. All feature contracts met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L661-666: paper_quote applies rc_cost only when round_corners=True. Formula is correct: math.ceil(q/pps) * per_stack, floored at rc_paper_min. Note: rc_paper_min is applied AFTER the multiplication, so a small qty (e.g. 10 pcs with pps=25 → 1 stack × $2 = $2) will be floored up to the minimum ($5). This matches the spec ('floored at a minimum'). Confirm business intent that min applies to computed charge, not to per-stack cost.

server.py L2472-2475: same rc formula for substrate uses total_qty (sum of sizes[].qty) — correct for Direct Print piece counting. Note the divisor default (pps=1) means every substrate piece is a stack, matching spec ('substrate defaults pieces_per_stack=1').

server.py L512: DISCOUNTABLE_FIELDS includes round_corner_retail/wholesale so volume discount correctly reduces the marked-up round-corner charge. round_corner_cost (raw cost) is intentionally NOT discounted — correct for margin reporting.

Metric.js L91: Round Corners line uses fallback `round_corner_retail ?? round_corner_wholesale` — good for role-scrubbed responses. But per_unit is not passed (no `unit` prop) — minor UI inconsistency with Lamination/Foil lines which show unit price. Consider adding `unit={r.qty ? v/r.qty : undefined}` for consistency.

Metric.js L8-19: `_rushCache` is a module-level cache never invalidated. If admin changes rush_same_day_pct/rush_next_day_pct in Settings and returns to a calculator without a full page reload, the Rush panel will still show the OLD percentages. Recommend: expose an invalidation hook (e.g., dispatch event on save-settings) or drop the cache and let the browser HTTP-cache /api/settings. Not blocking but user-visible for admin flow.

PaperPrinting.js L268-269: only round_corner_retail/wholesale are passed to PricingPanel, but not round_corner_cost — fine because PricingPanel only reads the *_retail/_wholesale for display. No change needed.
server.py still >3400 lines (repeated from iteration 32/33) — module split recommended.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Paper, Direct Print, Stickers, Settings persistence all verified)
